payload.objective: Implement the approved isolated CouncilFlow native model-routing and SkillLab experiment, then redesign README; preserve all frozen role/security boundaries.
instructions: Inspect project instructions and frozen charter already referenced by the original plan before implementation; preserve current role policy and all unrelated source history.

Do not inspect, reuse, copy, or mention A/B worker candidate implementations under experiments/native-model-routing/benchmark/arms. Treat that tree solely as sealed benchmark evidence. Do not modify the benchmark task, fixtures, oracle, assignments, candidate arms, tester artifacts, original plan, frozen Gate 3, or independent SkillLab repository.

Implement the smallest useful deterministic model routing/qualification contract in experiments/native-model-routing only. Exact route identity must include provider, route/endpoint id, model id and harness. Keep configured, requested, host-reported and independently effective identities distinct. Qualification evidence, validity, capabilities, availability/usage restrictions and reasoning support must be explicit. Do not invent any owner-approved model pool, entitlement, credentials, price, or qualification. Empty/unapproved policy must fail closed.

Implement selection and authorization as deterministic validation with role/task constraints and rationale. Include resource disposition classes enforced/estimated/reported, fail-closed request-vs-parent mismatch, identity mismatch, unsupported route/reasoning, missing/invalid credential indicators without echo, unverified/expired qualification, unauthorized fallback/escalation, limits, failed dispatch/retry, cancel/incomplete, worker/tester isolation metadata, and safe rollback semantics. This data helper is not a trusted Supervisor or security boundary.

Inspect actual native child-delegation API available in this host: explicit model and reasoning_effort are available on native collaboration invocation; this alone proves neither entitlement nor effective execution. Code the adapter as an explicit request only. When the configured host API cannot select distinct model, return UNSUPPORTED_NATIVE_MODEL_ROUTING. Never silently inherit the parent or claim actual dispatch. Record requested/host-reported/effective as unknown unless observable. Do not change the active parent session or global/provider configuration. No provider dispatch, credential access, network, or spending. Record the exact evidence boundary.

Build the minimal optional SkillLab Manager-side adapter under experiments/skilllab-integration/. Pin independent repo identity/version/registry SHA from evidence and use SkillLab existing validated public CLI/interface as suggestion only. Add no tools/actions/permissions, do not mutate SkillLab, keep seven candidate constraints and role bounds, distinguish selected vs activated. Test denied/unavailable/no-skill selections. Native skill activation must be marked unverified unless host evidence is available.

Add synthetic offline tests and representative negative controls for C06; label mock outcomes clearly. Preserve all existing tests. Include explicit tests for selection roles, exact identity, authorization, distinct assignment, unsupported effort, no credentials and redaction, qualification expiry/unverified, no unapproved fallback/escalation, resource-limit rejection, inherited parent mismatch, host reported mismatch, dispatch fail/retry, cancel/incomplete, blind Tester boundaries, rollback, and SkillLab eligibility/authority.

Redesign README with personality and concise accurate Mermaid role workflow, install/invoke, verified hosts, model-routing + SkillLab experimental status, test/evidence navigation, limits and preserved references. Check relative links and Mermaid/Markdown syntax with available offline tools.

Add technical documentation, reproducible benchmark outcome report including A/B evidence and limitations, exact local-host native routing capability evidence and NATIVE_MODEL_ROUTING_UNVERIFIED if no observable permitted route. A/B is descriptive, same requested gpt-6-luna/low, token/cost/duration data only if exposed, no causal claims.

Run relevant developer tests and release packaging if the shipped skill/plugin changes. Preserve binary/packaging conventions. Do not modify packages unless skill contents changed; rebuild reproducibly if so. No git commit/push/merge; Manager owns git. Write a CouncilFlow 1.0 Worker report to evidence/native-model-routing/worker-report.json replying to this assignment, bind candidate paths and SHA-256 hashes, actual changed files, checks/results and unknowns. Stop after report.
